name: The Modeva
shortDescription: A large low-rise condominium community in Bang Tao by Rhom Bho Property (The Title brand), with seven buildings and about 859 residences.
description:
The Modeva is a low-rise condominium community in the Bang Tao area of Thalang, developed by Rhom Bho Property, the company behind The Title brand. Project listings describe about 859 residences in seven buildings of seven storeys each, on a site of roughly 25,000 m², making it one of the larger developments in our catalogue.
Home types range from one-bedroom apartments of about 29–43 m² and one-bedroom Plus homes of 55–58 m² to two-bedroom apartments, two-bedroom duplexes of up to about 138 m² and three-bedroom duplexes of about 146–148 m². Shared facilities listed include a communal pool on the seventh floor and a reception lobby on the ground level. Units are offered within the Thai foreign quota.
The project is under construction. Portals quote different completion dates (from late 2026 to 2027), so we show none: please ask us to confirm the current construction status, price list and available units.
